purpose: Turn the active non-invariant spectral fallback into a finite executable matrix protocol once a selected D_E source is supplied.

accepted_sources: typed monad/Cech data plus induced HYM or Dolbeault-Hodge operator
corrected selected non-invariant A^(0,1) with integrability and residual bounds
direct selected HYM/Strominger solve with gauge fixing and residual certificate
rejected_sources: small invariant repair of printed A01

hilbert_space.space: H = L2(Omega^{0,*}(X,E)) or the sector-resolved bundle-valued spinor replacement
hilbert_space.operator: D_E with L_E = D_E^* D_E, or the corresponding Dolbeault Laplacian
domain_requirements: compact Iwasawa lattice or fundamental-domain boundary conditions
bundle transition law or chosen global frame with verified equivariance

finite_basis_protocol.nested_spaces: V_N subset H with projections P_N and P_N -> I strongly
basis_options: deck-equivariant spectral/Fourier basis on the compact Iwasawa quotient
finite-element or spectral-element basis on a fundamental domain with periodic/deck constraints
basis_checks: Gram matrix G_N is positive definite
basis respects the compact quotient identifications
basis is not just the invariant subspace
basis does not treat scalar central-circle Fourier modes as untwisted zero modes

matrix_protocol.family_projector: for a G_N-orthonormal eigenvector matrix V_fam, P_fam,N = V_fam V_fam^* G_N
matrix_protocol.green_operator: G_red,N = sum_{lambda_j outside family} lambda_j^{-1} v_j v_j^* G_N

gap_error_certificate.pass_rule: epsilon_low + eta_total < tau < gamma_gap - eta_total for some tau > 0
gap_error_certificate.consequence: the Riesz projector below tau has rank three and is stable under the certified errors

outputs_if_pass.anti_family_condition: anti-family modes absent or separated by the certified gap
outputs_if_pass.dotD_alpha1: dotD_alpha1: matrix of the selected C1 alpha1 variation in the same basis
outputs_if_pass.cubic_or_overlap_tensor: E6 cubic or sector overlap tensor evaluated on Psi_i

verdict.next_step: Fill this protocol with one selected D_E source and a first finite non-invariant basis V_N.
